name: Ember Erikstad
role: Personnel recovery and hostile extraction — extraction specialist
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Ashland and Division
description:
Nika Svensson-Kone is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 33, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a extraction specialist out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented extraction specialist in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Nika Svensson-Kone murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
example_lines: "We go in, we get the asset, we leave. Everything else is improvisation."
"The extraction window is four minutes. I've done it in three."
"I don't rescue people. I relocate them aggressively."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Nika Svensson-Kone once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Nika Svensson-Kone discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A dead drop Nika Svensson-Kone maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Nika Svensson-Kone represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms. Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian with significant Eastern European and South Asian ancestry, creating striking feature blending: East Asian bone structure (high, prominent cheekbones, almond eye shape) softened by Eastern European and South Asian warmth. Genetic complexity evident in unexpected color contrasts — dark blonde hair unusual but genetically plausible from the Eastern European component, while facial structure and skin undertones reflect the 37.6% East Asian dominance.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — dancer's grace combined with fighter's efficiency. Shoulders broad but not bulky, legs powerful and economical. No wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark blonde with natural silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid that sits high on the crown — practical for work, reveals the nape where spinal chrome terminates
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm honey-bronze with subtle golden undertones — the East Asian dominance creates warmer, deeper base tone than her Scandinavian-influenced hair might suggest. Luminous quality across cheekbones, warmer cream tones at the jawline with slight ruddy undertones from South Asian ancestry.
physical_description.complexion: East Asian-influenced facial geometry with prominent, high cheekbones and defined jawline that catches light sharply. Skin weathered by nocturnal living — slight circles under eyes that no amount of sleep erasure can fully eliminate. A thin scar traces her left temple, barely visible unless light catches it directly. Subtle asymmetry in face shape reflecting the genetic diversity — minor epicanthal fold quality softened by Eastern European influences.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running the length of her cervical spine, visible when she wears anything backless — chrome interface ports flush with skin at C3 and C5 vertebrae
Thin white line across left temple, approximately 4cm, angled toward her hairline — old blade work
Faint burn marks on the inside of her right forearm — three parallel lines, deliberate, old enough to be pale against her skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Reflex booster chrome visible along the spine — iridescent titanium-alloy ports at cervical vertebrae catch light when she moves. The metallic sheen is impossible to hide; she doesn't try. Synthetic lung architecture visible in the subtle way her ribcage moves — slightly different biomechanics than natural respiration, noticeable only if you're watching closely.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled — no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced toward the balls of her feet, ready for immediate action. Moves like she's always calculating distance and angles. Hands are rarely still; fidgets with equipment, adjusts straps, tests weapon weight. Eye contact direct and held slightly too long — unsettling to most people.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional gear — well-maintained but worn. Black synthetic bodysuit with reinforced panels at shoulders, ribs, and thighs (impact protection). Armored jacket over top — matte tactical weave with cargo pockets, sleeves cut short to reveal forearm augmentation scars. Combat boots, laced tight. Webbing harness for tools and weapons — organized with military precision. No decoration, no excess. Everything serves a purpose or doesn't exist.
